scenes.title: My desk
scenes.description: A familiar workspace reconstructed from an original video, with screens, a laptop, and everyday details.

scenes.title: Dozer · estimated cameras
scenes.description: An excavator and its surroundings, reconstructed from source photographs with locally estimated camera poses.

scenes.title: Dozer · supplied cameras
scenes.description: The first local reconstruction of this outdoor scene, using the dataset’s provided camera poses.

scenes.title: Houseplant
scenes.description: Leaves and a small pot, captured as a Gaussian scene by Marcel Padilla and shared under CC BY 4.0.

scenes.title: Beijing · observed 10k
scenes.description: Real photographs only; fixed panorama rigs. Blurred structures and stretched geometry remain.

scenes.title: Beijing · generated input
scenes.description: Local diffusion output was included in Metal training. An integration experiment, not evidence of improved reconstruction.
scenes.detail: 48 real + 1 generated view · 2,000 steps · Quality FAIL

scenes.title: Beijing · depth-guided generated view
scenes.description: Observed pixels were reprojected with locally calibrated relative depth; masked MPS diffusion supplied the remaining pixels. The generated view has an estimated, reused pose and does not establish new geometry.
scenes.detail: 48 real + 1 depth-guided synthetic view · 10,000 Metal steps · Quality FAIL

scenes.title: Beijing · capacity 20k
scenes.description: Longer training and larger capacity together; held-view PSNR fell from 14.72 to 12.68 dB.

scenes.title: Beijing · observed 2k
scenes.description: The first constrained-rig Gaussian baseline. Training and export worked, while the reconstructed appearance remained blurry.

scenes.title: Beijing · matched real-only baseline
scenes.description: The matched real-only baseline for the 65-frame panorama experiment. Its rendered building edges remain blurry; target #5 geometry participated in all-image SfM.
scenes.detail: 48 real crops · 10,000 Metal steps · Quality FAIL

scenes.title: Beijing · 65-frame interpolation GS
scenes.description: The generated midpoint was added to Metal Gaussian training. It renders but adds streaked geometry and did not improve either inspected target view.

scenes.title: Dozer · 30-step smoke
scenes.description: Initial native execution test with only 30 training steps. This is a separate exported result, not the accepted 1,500-step scene.

scenes.title: Dozer · fresh proof rerun
scenes.description: A fresh local 1,500-step Metal run retained as reconstruction evidence; this PLY differs from the original export.

scenes.title: Dozer · partial 16/40 poses
scenes.description: The early pose-estimation attempt registered only 16 of 40 photographs. Its sparse Gaussian output is retained for observation.

scenes.title: Dozer · 24-view trial
scenes.description: A small end-to-end local pipeline run using supplied lens calibration and newly estimated camera positions.

scenes.title: My desk · initial 15s trial
scenes.description: The first 15-second crop of the creator recording, with the earlier system HDR conversion. The later full capture is separately available.
